title: Montjuic hill repeats 6x4min
terrain: Barcelona, Montjuic road/park climbs 5-8%; fallback hotel treadmill 8%

steps.target: Z1-Z2, 130-150bpm, run to the base of Montjuic

coachNotes:
EXECUTION: 20min easy to Montjuic. 6x4min uphill at 165-172bpm, cadence 175+, short steps, jog back down 3min. 15min easy home. Start by 06:45 to finish before the summit (~1h20 total, ~300m D+).
FALLBACK: hotel treadmill, 6x4min at 8% incline, 10-11km/h, 3min flat jog at 8km/h.
GYM: none.
FUEL: water; breakfast after.
GARMIN: ~280-340 (intervals run ~3.5-4x icu).
STOP RULE: HRV under 55 or under 6h sleep after the flight, cut to 4 reps. HR over 175 on rep 1, cap the rest at 168.
WHY: VWT climbs are short and steep; threshold on a hill builds the climbing engine without a flat-road pounding.
